result.summary: Narrow GitHub Actions release automation pack for small dev teams: install one reusable workflow that generates changelogs, labels tickets, and sends deploy summaries, sold as a fixed-scope setup plus support.
result.opportunity: Small software teams still do release-note generation, issue labeling, and deployment notifications manually across GitHub repos. The pain is repetitive, visible in the repo, and easy to quantify in minutes saved per release.
result.target_customer: Small SaaS teams and agencies in Spain/Europe with 2-15 engineers, active GitHub repos, and a release cadence of at least biweekly or monthly.
result.offer: Release Ship Pack: repository audit, one GitHub Actions workflow for PR-to-changelog, release-note generation, issue labeling/triage, and Slack/Discord/email deploy summary; includes setup, documentation and 2 weeks of support.
result.why_now: GitHub Actions is a standard, documented platform for CI/CD and release automation; teams commonly still hand-edit changelogs and deploy notifications, so a small repeatable workflow saves clear engineering time without a full platform build.
actions_completed: Reviewed the 100-route monetization playbook and the 5 seeded routes; inspected recent competitor attempts IAMO499-IAMO518; reviewed CobrAMO payment infrastructure; read GitHub Actions and release documentation to validate a real workflow pain and a productized setup offer.

execution_packet.channel: Personalized email or LinkedIn message to a technical founder or CTO via public company contact page or GitHub profile, offering a 30-minute repo audit and a fixed-scope setup.
execution_packet.subject: GitHub release automation for your repo
execution_packet.message: Hi [Name], I noticed your repo still handles release notes / issue labels / deploy notifications manually. I can set up one reusable GitHub Actions workflow that generates a changelog from merged PRs, applies release labels, and sends a concise Slack or email summary after each deploy. This is a fixed-scope setup for 299 EUR plus optional support at 49 EUR/month, and I can show a sample workflow in 15 minutes. Payment is via CobrAMO and the order reference is RANK-IAMO519. If this is useful, I can send a 1-page sample for one repo and we can confirm the exact workflow you need.
execution_packet.deliverable: One GitHub Actions workflow file, repo-specific configuration, changelog/release note template, labels or Slack summary, and a short setup guide plus 2 weeks of support.

result.differentiation_from_previous: I moved away from saturated GBP, Shopify feed and generic review products. This is narrower than the broad CI setup used by IAMO499: I target one highly visible release workflow (PR-to-changelog + labels + deploy summary), package it as a fixed-scope service, and sell outcomes rather than a generic 'CI automation' promise.
result.next_step: Identify 15-20 small SaaS teams and agencies with public GitHub repos and a visible release routine, inspect one repo for manual release notes or label work, then send a 1-personalized note with two concrete repo observations and the 299 EUR setup offer.
result.notes: Considered the seeded routes #19 and #99, plus #36/#40, and rejected #39/#59 because the evidence for local-review and video/demo demand is crowded and less direct. GitHub Actions is the strongest match to a real external market and a fast, low-cost proof point. No payment has been received; this remains an execution plan, not revenue.
